verdict.rationale: The only evidenced batch-style capability is Weave's own Evaluation workflow, which runs scoring functions over a whole Dataset of test examples, plus scoring an entire Thread of calls at once. There is no documented general bulk-operation feature for acting on many items together, such as bulk tagging, deleting, editing, or exporting traces. missing for 10: documented bulk edit/delete/tag/export operations on calls or objects, bulk-operation API endpoints, UI multi-select actions, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: the core of the workflow is the _`Evaluation` object_, which defines: A `Dataset` or list of dictionaries for test examples. One or more scoring functions.
You can use Threads to analyze or score the entire conversation instead of individual Calls.
You can test new LLMs and custom models against production traces, assessing their performance for your specific use cases.
